# ModDB — historical Windows 1.1 patch record

- Original source: [ModDB — historical Windows 1.1 patch record](https://www.moddb.com/games/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/downloads/robin-hood-patch-1-1)
- Author / publication: GameWatcher uploader / ModDB
- Language / date: English; added 2003-08-13
- Access: File listing and description inspected; binary not downloaded
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The archived listing identifies rh_update_1.1.exe, sized 3,072,190 bytes. Its description says the update addresses lag under Windows 98 and Windows ME specifically.

This narrow operating-system scope matters: a historical lag fix is not evidence that this executable resolves modern Windows rendering or timing problems. The uploader presents it as an archived file without support.

The record preserves patch provenance and the distributor's stated purpose. No installer was downloaded, executed, or compared with the repository's game data, and the description does not supply a comprehensive changelog.
